errors.text: The required SRO validation cell is not reconstructed: the target uses a 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell, whereas the hypothesis only estimates more than 100 atoms.

Electronic excitations are treated as a condition the MTP might need to learn or avoid, although the target treats the electronic Gibbs contribution explicitly and finds it essential, shifting melting by 48-57 K.
The cited evidence does not support the quantitative claims about MTP/FEP accuracy, computational savings, SRO stabilization, electronic free energies, or melting-temperature shifts.
